title: handle_state_change: message_state not updated on stateMismatch full-reload
description: In handle_state_change when Message/changes returns stateMismatch, the code does a full reload via load_messages_for_chat and then sets state.message_state = sc.new_state.clone(). But load_messages_for_chat does NOT return the server's message state — it fetches message content without capturing the Message/get state field. The SSE event's new_state may not match the actual current state returned by the Message/get response. On the next SSE event, sinceState will be sc.new_state which may be stale if more messages arrived between the stateMismatch error and the full reload completing. The correct fix is to capture the 'state' field from the Message/get response and use that as message_state.
